notablePrerequisites: You've lost 2 or more life this turn.
easyPrerequisites: You have not completed, or are venturing in, Tomb of Annihilation.
description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
When Acererak enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Acererak, adding {B}.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat from step 2.
